slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Fixed EEPROM blocks 32-34 within a 128B read allocation (blocks 32-47) via FUN_0816ab08(0x10,2) from FUN_08156508. Validity = seed-7 sum16 checksum at logical 0x116; on failure FUN_08156508 substitutes RAM defaults, never selects another copy. No backup/mirror and no generation counter exist.

checksums.name: slotB_sum16_seed7
checksums.formula_detail: Logical (per-8-byte-block-reversed) image: acc=7; for i in 0..10: acc=(acc + u16_le[logical 0x100+i*2]) & 0xFFFF; stored u16_le at logical 0x116 (word 11). Raw file: reversing each 8-byte block of sav-00-f1492.sav gives the logical image; stored raw bytes are at raw 0x110-0x111 = 00 0d. No complement/XOR/CRC. Decompiled proof: FUN_08156508 at 0x08156508 (decompiled.c:380-389).

io_driver_functions.notes: Load+validate+deserialize Slot B. Calls FUN_0816a924, FUN_0816ab08(0x10,2), FUN_0816a998; on read error calls untraced func_0x0816ab68; on checksum failure installs defaults ([1,0,0,0,0,0], 2, 2, 0, [0,0]). Caller not in callgraph (indirect dispatch); graph lists it caller-less.
Same function also verifies seed-7 sum16 over logical words 0-10 vs word 11 (also listed under checksums). Duplicate entry only to satisfy role enumeration.

EEPROM block-read helper: for i in 0..count-1 calls thunk FUN_0817faf0(block=i+page*16, dest), dest += 8 per block, returns first non-zero char. Called as (0x10, 2) = blocks 32-47, 128 bytes. Per-block DMA3/EEPROM implementation behind thunk 0x0817faf0 is not in corpus; no 0x0D000000 reference in any traced function.

UNKNOWN: called only when FUN_0816ab08 returns non-zero (read error). Body not decompiled (func_0x0816ab68 external). Plausibly EEPROM format/write-defaults, but unverified; role is a placeholder hypothesis, not a confirmed write.

Bracketing helper before EEPROM read: clears DISPCNT bit12 (0x04000000 &= 0xEFFF), calls FUN_0817d738, func_0x0817facc(3, ptr), sets RAM flags 0/1 (literals 0x0816a990/0x0816a994). Does not mutate save fields. Role marks participation in the read transaction, not a media transfer.
Bracketing helper after EEPROM read: sets DISPCNT bit12 (0x04000000 |= 0x1000), writes 3 to 0x04000200 (REG_IE), restores pointer fields. Does not mutate save fields.
One-instruction indirect thunk ((*pcRam0817faf8)()); target per-block EEPROM transfer routine not in corpus.

FALSE POSITIVE seed: DMA3 (0x040000D4/D8/DC), CNT 0x85000100, source=stack, dest=literal uRam081558cc (value not in corpus), preceded by callback-table walk. No 0x0D000000 endpoint; graphics DMA, not save I/O.
FALSE POSITIVE seed: DMA3 CNT 0x85000040 inside sprite/entity update loop (0x18-byte records). No 0x0D000000 endpoint; not save I/O.
FALSE POSITIVE seed: DMA3 CNT 0x81000400, dest proven 0x06001800 (VRAM) in code. Graphics fill/copy, definitively not save media.
Generic Thumb DMA-copy wrapper (address regs + count|0x80000000, spins on count bit15). Never called with 0x0D000000/0x0E000000 by traced code.

open_questions: Where is the EEPROM writer/serial driver (DMA3 to 0x0D000000) and what triggers it? No traced function references 0x0D000000, 0x0E000000, 0x5555/0x2AAA, or WAITCNT 0x04000204.
What is func_0x0816ab68 (0x0816ab68), called by FUN_08156508 only on EEPROM read error - format/write-defaults or something else? Body not in corpus.
What reads/writes Slot A (EEPROM blocks 0-1, logical words [3,0,0,0,0,0,3,0xFFFF]) and what is its validity rule, if any?
Gameplay semantics and valid ranges of Slot B words 0-10 (6-entry array [1,0,0,0,0,0], bytes 2,2,0, pair [1,0]) are unknown; only types/destinations/defaults are verified.
What loads the second 6-byte RAM array (literal 0x08156664), which FUN_08156508 only defaults on checksum failure?
Actual RAM addresses behind ROM literal-pool symbols 0x0815665c-0x08156674 are not recoverable from decompiled.c (pointer values not included); ram_addr is null for all fields for this reason.
Is Slot B's true structure only 24 bytes, or do untraced consumers use the 104 erased tail bytes of its 128-byte allocation (blocks 35-47)?
Which in-game events mutate the RAM save fields before a flush (level completion, options, game over)? None were traced (trace ends frame 1620, boot/title only).
Who calls FUN_08156508? callgraph.json lists it caller-less (indirect/jump-table dispatch), so the boot caller chain above it is unmapped.
